scope_statement: Independent study of process mining as event data linked to explicit process representations through discovery, conformance, enhancement, organisational/performance analysis, temporal monitoring and related predictive/prescriptive methods; includes responsible use and current object-centric, uncertain, federated and language-assisted frontiers.
scope_boundaries: No requester repositories, runtime designs, previous Evolved packets or sibling outputs used.
No exhaustive census of every publication, commercial product, algorithm variant or industrial deployment.
No normative legal compliance assessment or medical advice; authority/privacy/fairness are analytical boundaries and research concerns.
Original formal-modelling precursors are examined through their explicit use in primary mining papers; some 1998 originals, the full IEEE standard and the monograph have stated access limits.
Current evidence means accessible by 2026-09-06; future issue dates, preprints, conference/journal versions and repeated datasets remain distinct.
The Evolved composition and its analytical probes are not represented as an independently validated academic school or tested organisational implementation.

saturation_rationale.BASIS: Decision saturation within the declared questions, not a fixed source count, property count or number of search rounds.
saturation_rationale.OBSERVED_CLOSURE: Every mandatory family has inspected evidence, criticism, a developed domain model, candidate dispositions and current-state limits. Further searches were used where they could change a judgement: full text-to-event research, experimental methodology and calibration theory did change the records.
WHAT_CHANGED_LATE: S055 narrowed text-extraction transfer while supporting a concrete mechanism.
S056 strengthened the distinction between methodology/checklist presence and valid experimental reasoning.
S057/S058 narrowed uncertainty claims and separated probability calibration from marginal coverage.
Composition exposed EPM-084, increasing the denominator from 83 to 84 without renumbering.
saturation_rationale.STOPPING_JUDGEMENT: The remaining burdens concern missing independent external validation, inaccessible exact editions or unresolved semantic compatibility, rather than unread mandatory families. Repeating equivalent discovery queries would not by itself resolve those evidence gaps.
saturation_rationale.NOT_CLAIMED: This is not a PRISMA-style exhaustive literature census, statistical meta-analysis or proof that no further relevant study exists.

uncompleted_burdens_explanation: No mandatory family or registered candidate is NOT_EXAMINED. Examined unresolved records and access/transfer limits are retained and do not imply universal closure.
source_independence_statement: Separate papers or publication years are not assumed to be independent; empirical units and dependence groups resolve in SOURCE_TABLE.json.
